summary: MacKenzie Realty Capital Inc. filed an amended Form 8-K solely to correct a hyperlink in its original May 15, 2026 filing. The underlying disclosure is a routine announcement of quarterly financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026, with a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a procedural amendment with no material corporate event.
